bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to environment; appropriating money for a wood upcycling campus.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; WOOD UPCYCLING CAMPUS.

$23,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Pollution Control Agency for a grant to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Nursery and Landscape Association to construct a wood upcycling campus to process wood waste into lumber, furniture, building materials, and other wood products; compost, mulch, and biochar; and energy production.
additions: $23,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Pollution Control Agency for a grant to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Nursery and Landscape Association to construct a wood upcycling campus to process wood waste into lumber, furniture, building materials, and other wood products; compost, mulch, and biochar; and energy production.
